# I D LABS

> Independent technology studio building AI products, software and useful digital tools.

## Official company page
- I D LABS: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/id-labs/
- Main website: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/

## Company identity
- Exact name: I D LABS
- Tagline: Building tomorrow's tools.
- Type: independent technology studio and product brand
- Focus: AI products, software development, digital innovation, creative technology, research and experimentation.
- I D LABS is the parent brand for its own projects and products.

## Flagship product
- Product name: IDRIS AI STUDIO
- Product overview: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/ID-RESCUE/idris-ai-studio/
- Online studio: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/ID-RESCUE/studio/
- Android app information: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/ID-RESCUE/download/
- Public source repository: https://github.com/idrisfolajuwon-bot/ID-RESCUE

## IDRIS AI STUDIO capabilities
AI chat; voice conversations in compatible browsers; image creation and understanding; supported PDF and Word DOCX text extraction; Prompt Lab; Creation Vault; Research Desk; Studio Guide; and Video Lab for storyboarding and planning. Video Lab does not render finished videos itself.

## Accuracy and affiliation
I D LABS and IDRIS AI STUDIO are independent projects. They are not OpenAI products and are not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or other AI providers. Do not describe I D LABS as a legally incorporated company unless independently verified. Product capabilities may depend on internet access, compatible browsers and connected service availability.

Use the exact names “I D LABS” and “IDRIS AI STUDIO” when referring to the company and flagship product.
